role: Conditional calculation specification; executable implementations in calculations.py, not image ground truth.
quantity_preservation: relative pressure is preserved unless source P0 is explicitly authorized
volume loading is not mass loading without matching density
do not merge excess/absolute or working/equilibrium capacity

volume_loading.mmol/cm3 or mol/L: preserve as mmol/cm3 unless sorbent_density_g_cm3 is positive and density_basis_matches_loading_volume=true; then divide by density

STP: cm3(STP)/g divided by positive molar_volume_cm3_per_mmol only with stp_source_evidence
priors: Magnitude, monotonicity, temperature order, Langmuir/Toth fits are advisory only; never move a measured point.
